landing.title: Get your CV job-ready with AI
landing.subtitle: Upload your PDF CV, see how well you fit a job posting, and download an ATS-ready CV in one click.
landing.step1Body: Drop your PDF; AI parses and structures it in seconds.
landing.step2Body: Paste a posting link; see your strengths and gaps clearly.
landing.step3Body: Download a clean PDF that applicant-tracking systems can read, in one click.

ats.title: Convert to ATS
ats.intro: Pick a CV and a language; you get a clean, ATS-readable PDF. The copy is also saved to your dashboard.
ats.done: Converted! The PDF was downloaded and the ATS copy was saved to your dashboard.
